company.name: Artemis Search
company.shortDescription: Artemis Search is a software company that develops AI-based sales prospecting and vector search software for B2B lead generation.
company.description: Artemis Search develops artificial intelligence software for sales prospecting and vector-based information retrieval. The company provides an application that connects to LinkedIn Sales Navigator to automate account-based prospecting and assemble context-specific decision-maker lists. Its platform uses deep learning ranking models and vector search to evaluate how well underlying data matches the intent of a query, rather than relying only on keyword similarity. Artemis Search offers infrastructure and developer tools that expose its task-specialized ranking architectures and vector search technology through APIs and control environments. These tools are designed for B2B teams that need targeted contact discovery and more precise search behavior across professional data sources. The company focuses on reducing manual list building and improving the relevance of leads produced by enterprise search workflows.
